answer: Mutual audit blocks bulk fake identities. Each identity locks a 70 bond, files one signed record, joins a grove of five. Each epoch a fresh draw pairs members to mirror each other's work on the log. A record failing replay is a fable, an invented tale, and burns its bond. A rented mirror stamping a fable shares the burn. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 110 = 110,000 on a 40,000 pool, a net loss of 70,000. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its share.
